headline: Multi-omics tensor and pathway methods broaden integrated cancer data analysis
label: Multi Omics Integration Resources
summary: Recent preprints and publications pair tensor decomposition, pathway scoring and metabolic flux inference with curated multi-omics cancer resources.
synthesis: The common thread is integrating heterogeneous molecular layers through tensor, pathway or database frameworks. HIT-Fuse fuses six omics and pathomics modalities with autoencoders and CP decomposition, tolerating missing modalities, while a hippocampal-colonic study applies HOSVD to transcriptomic and methylation data to select aging-linked genes. PathwayTheme inverts the usual PCA order by scoring pathways per sample and testing components against biological and technical covariates. Resources such as PDAC BioPortal, PTMlink across 1,211 CPTAC tumor samples, and DriverDBv5 make integrated data queryable, and M-SCAN infers sample-specific metabolic fluxes across TCGA and GTEx. What is new is explicit modelling of cross-layer coupling; the items do not show cross-cohort validation.
